parts.label: (a)
parts.text: With reference to the photoelectric effect, state what is meant by work function energy.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
The work function energy of a clean metal surface is $5.5\times10^{-19}\text{ J}$.

Electromagnetic radiation of wavelength $280\text{ nm}$ is incident on the metal surface. The metal is in a vacuum.
parts.text:
Calculate:

1. the photon energy

photon energy = ........................................ J [2]

2. the maximum speed $v_{\mathrm{MAX}}$ of the electrons emitted from the surface.

$v_{\mathrm{MAX}}=$ ........................................ $\text{m s}^{-1}$ [3]

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why most of the emitted electrons will have a speed lower than $v_{\mathrm{MAX}}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
